policy: Scoped, expiring exceptions to the npm audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.ts). See docs/adr/0019-dev-audit-exceptions.md. An entry covers its advisory only while every affected dependency path passes through one of requiredAncestors; any other path fails the gate. Severity is the advisory severity at decision time; a change forces re-review.

exceptions.reason: Nested zod@3.25.76 copies installed only by dev dependency promptfoo@0.116.7 (promptfoo/node_modules/zod and its @adaline/* provider adapters). The fix requires promptfoo 0.125.1 (breaking); 0.116.7 is kept to preserve reproducibility of accepted Phase 10 / M2 eval evidence. The runtime zod is pinned at the patched 4.6.6. The local eval profile validates only reviewed handwritten fixtures, not untrusted collections.

Nested glob@11.1.0 installed only by dev dependency promptfoo@0.116.7. The fix requires promptfoo 0.125.1 (breaking); kept for M2 eval reproducibility. The runtime glob (via @fastify/static 10.1.10) is the patched 14.0.4. The eval profile does not pass AbortSignal-cancelled globs over untrusted directories.

Dev-only minimatch@10.2.6 used by the lint toolchain (eslint 10.12.0, @eslint/config-array, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree) and by promptfoo's nested glob. No patched 10.x exists and current eslint/typescript-eslint releases still require ^10; forcing 11.x would be a major override of the linter. Patterns come from repository-controlled lint/eval configuration, not untrusted input. Also dev-only via @stryker-mutator/core 10.1.1 (requires ~10.2.4), which matches mutate/ignore patterns from repository-controlled stryker.config.json (added 2026-11-12). Also dev-only via c8 12.0.0 (test-exclude), which matches include/exclude patterns from the repository CI workflow (added 2026-11-13).
